scripts.deploy: npm run context && wrangler deploy --var VERSION:$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
scripts.logs: wrangler d1 execute nathancj-chat --remote --command "SELECT ts, outcome, asked_nathan AS ask, substr(question,1,80) AS question, substr(answer,1,80) AS answer FROM chat_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 25"
scripts.logs:local: wrangler d1 execute nathancj-chat --local --command "SELECT ts, outcome, asked_nathan AS ask, substr(question,1,80) AS question, substr(answer,1,80) AS answer FROM chat_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 25"
